retained_limits: Excel web General coercion and Paste Values tab removal prevent a universally lossless default round trip.
No apostrophes, formulas, zero-width prefixes, destination-specific copy controls, or hidden text were added to clipboard values.
Desktop Excel, other browsers/platforms, IME, accessibility, OS failures and input latency remain unverified.
method_notes: Temporary synthetic-only clipboard capture instrumentation was removed before final checks and release.
Earlier scratch source resets conflicted with saved collaboration checkpoints; file guards rejected opens. Final cases used fresh paths without deleting checkpoints.
Native screenshots were inspected in-session; saved evidence contains only synthetic source and metadata digests.
privacy: Workbook identifiers, account data, clipboard tracking timestamps/user hashes/copy IDs and browser accessibility trees are omitted.
